problem.title: You don't have time. Your competitor does.
problem.subtitle: The Netherlands has more than 1.8 million small businesses. Most of them run into the same six things.

items.title: Reviews go unanswered
items.body: No reply means a lower position in Google Maps. Every week without a response costs you visibility.

items.title: Social media has stalled
items.body: 78% of small businesses don't post regularly. Your competitor posts daily; your account is weeks old.

items.title: An agency is too expensive
items.body: A social media agency costs €300 to €800 a month. For a shop with five staff that simply doesn't add up.

items.title: You want AI, but how?
items.body: 67% say they want to use AI but don't know how. The barrier is the technology, not the willingness.

items.title: 30% commission per order
items.body: Delivery platforms take up to 30% of every order. There is no alternative for reaching customers directly.

items.title: Lapsed customers go unnoticed
items.body: A regular who hasn't been in for three weeks often never comes back. And nobody notices.

day.title: A day with SmallBusinessAI
day.subtitle: You just run your business. Everything else happens in the background and arrives on WhatsApp.

items.title: You open up
items.body: The two-star review that came in at 02:14 has already been answered. The weekly report is waiting on WhatsApp.

items.title: Instagram post is ready
items.body: "Freshly sliced chicken döner today." You send "1". The post is live.

items.title: Lunch rush
items.body: No time to touch your phone. Meanwhile three DM questions have been answered automatically.

items.title: Competitor cuts prices
items.body: WhatsApp message: "Döner King is €0.50 cheaper. Try a combo deal?" You approve; the campaign runs.

items.title: It starts raining
items.body: KNMI data triggers automatically: "Free drink with delivery tonight." 23 direct orders, zero commission.

items.title: You head home
items.body: Four reviews answered, one campaign run, €67 in commission saved. Your time spent: two minutes.

modules.title: Five modules, one WhatsApp number
modules.subtitle: Each module is a set of AI agents that work on their own. Together they're stronger; separately they still work.

items.q: Do I have to learn a new app?
items.a: No. Everything runs through WhatsApp, the same app you already use all day. Alerts, approvals and reports arrive as normal messages. There is also a web panel, but it's optional.

items.q: Will the AI post things in my name on its own?
items.a: Never without your approval. Every reply and every post comes to you as a draft first. You send "1" to publish or "2" to edit. You stay fully in control.

items.q: Won't it sound like a robot?
items.a: We tune the tone to your business: casual or formal, with or without emoji, Dutch or Turkish. After the first week the system learns from the replies you edited yourself.

items.q: What happens to my customer data?
items.a: Everything is processed and stored inside the EU, fully GDPR compliant. You get a data processing agreement. You can export or delete your data at any time.

items.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
items.a: The first month is free and non-binding. After that there is a three-month minimum, because the initial setup takes work on our side. After that it's cancellable monthly.

items.q: I'd rather speak Turkish or Arabic.
items.a: That's fine. Onboarding, the panel and every WhatsApp message are available in Dutch, Turkish, German and English. Replies to your customers stay in Dutch by default.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: SmallBusinessAI processes personal data belonging to the businesses that use our service and to their customers. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

body: SmallBusinessAI, based in Amsterdam and registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce under number 00000000, is the data controller for its customers' data and a data processor for the data it handles on behalf of customers.
Contact: privacy@smallbusinessai.nl
Account data: name, email address, phone number, business name, Chamber of Commerce number and billing address.
Google Business Profile data: reviews, ratings, opening hours and business information. We read this only after you have explicitly granted us access through Google OAuth.
Social media data: posts, statistics and direct messages from connected Instagram and Facebook accounts, only after your approval through Meta.
WhatsApp data: phone numbers and messages exchanged through the WhatsApp Business Platform.
Usage data: login details, IP address and actions inside the panel, for security and troubleshooting.
To deliver the service: fetch reviews, generate draft replies, publish after your approval and produce reports.
To notify you on WhatsApp about new reviews, campaigns and reports.
To improve the service and resolve faults.
To meet legal obligations, such as the seven-year tax retention requirement for invoices.

We process data on the basis of performing our contract with you, on the basis of your consent (for example when connecting Google or Meta), and on the basis of a legitimate interest in security and service improvement.
You can withdraw consent at any time by disconnecting the integration in your panel.
We use language models from Anthropic (Claude) to generate draft text. Review text and business information are sent to this processor for that purpose.
This data is not used to train the models.
Generated text is never published automatically. Publication happens only after you have explicitly approved it.

We share data only with processors needed to deliver the service: Google (Business Profile API), Meta (WhatsApp and Graph API), Anthropic (AI), Supabase (database), Vercel and Railway (hosting), Mollie and Stripe (payments).
We have a data processing agreement with all of these parties. We never sell data to third parties.
We keep account data for as long as you are a customer and for twelve months afterwards.
We keep reviews and generated replies for twenty-four months for reporting purposes.
We keep invoices for seven years under Dutch tax law.
After cancellation you can request deletion; we then remove everything we are not legally required to keep within thirty days.
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection and data portability.
Send your request to privacy@smallbusinessai.nl. We respond within thirty days.
If you disagree with how we handle it, you can lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
Data is encrypted in storage and in transit. Google and Meta access tokens are encrypted separately.
Access within our team is limited to those who need it. We keep access logs.
We may update this policy. For significant changes we will notify you by email and in the panel at least thirty days in advance.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply to the use of SmallBusinessAI by business customers.

body: SmallBusinessAI provides software that lets business owners answer reviews, manage social media and communicate with customers, supported by artificial intelligence.
The service is provided as a subscription and billed monthly or annually.
The first month is free and non-binding.
After the trial a minimum term of three months applies. After that the subscription can be cancelled monthly with one month's notice.
Cancellation is possible through the panel or by email.
All text the system generates is a draft. Publication happens only after explicit approval by the customer.
The customer remains responsible for content published under their business name.
SmallBusinessAI is not liable for the consequences of publications approved by the customer.
The service uses services from Google, Meta, Mollie and Stripe. Those providers' own terms also apply to these integrations.
Changes or outages in those services may affect operation. We make every effort to resolve faults as quickly as possible.
We aim for 99% availability per month, excluding planned maintenance announced in advance.
Planned maintenance windows fall outside regular opening hours where possible.
Payment is by direct debit, iDEAL or credit card.
If payment is not received, the service may be suspended after two reminders.
All amounts are exclusive of 21% Dutch VAT.
Participants receive commission on paying customers they refer, for as long as that customer pays.
Commission is paid monthly from a balance of €50.
Self-referral, misleading advertising and spam lead to exclusion.
Our liability is limited to the amount the customer paid in the twelve months preceding the incident.
We are not liable for lost profit or indirect damages.
Dutch law applies to this agreement. Disputes will be submitted to the competent court in Amsterdam.
